findings.conclusion: Determine whether a binding exists only after taking the job serialization lock, then take the outbox lock and validate a fresh lease clock. An initial unlocked lookup may identify the job but must not decide the no-binding branch. A concurrent reservation must lead to the existing bound-scope path, including cross-deployment denial.

transaction_order: Authenticate session_user OID/name via h2_identity(dispatcher), retaining principal FOR SHARE fence.
Load immutable command/job relation to identify job; absent command is forbidden.
Use existing project guard -> membership FOR UPDATE NOWAIT -> job FOR UPDATE -> binding FOR UPDATE if present -> workspace FOR SHARE ordering through h2_lock_job.
Re-read binding and all branch predicates after serialization. If binding exists, require its deployment to match authenticated dispatcher and use existing bound incident semantics.
Lock the exact command outbox FOR UPDATE. Check state leased, exact command ID/generation/token and claim_expires_at > freshly sampled clock_timestamp; missing/null lease facts are stale.

Only in the confirmed no-binding case evaluate the strict prebinding predicates and atomically update the exact active delivery_attempt plus exact outbox. Never lock outbox then request earlier classes.
unbound_predicates: Authenticated current active dispatcher OID/name; require its owner-registered deployment to exist and remain enabled for this new unbound authority. No caller principal/deployment/build identity is accepted.
Command is exact jobs.create_command_id, route POST /api/v1/jobs, same job/project/owner actor relation and still accepted; job remains DRAFT revision0. Derive these facts from DB, not caller claims.
No execution_binding exists under the job lock. No build/namespace/run/receipt/scope is manufactured.

Exact current workspace_intent belongs to this job and create command. If current intent is not READY, return fixed wait WORKSPACE_NOT_READY with accepted command and leased outbox/attempt unchanged; dispatcher may separately release/retry through record_delivery.

Only code WORKSPACE_IDENTITY_CONFLICT is accepted in this no-binding branch. All other/NULL/unknown codes fail with fixed private error and zero mutations. Bound branch retains the existing fixed-code allowlist.
Require exact live lease and its current unfinished attempt. A missing attempt is protocol inconsistency, not permission to fabricate or partially complete a quarantine.
unbound_mutations: Update only delivery_attempts(command_id,p_generation) with completed_at from DB clock, result quarantined and error_code WORKSPACE_IDENTITY_CONFLICT.

Update only that command outbox to quarantined, clear claim_token/claim_expires_at and set fixed last_error. Return fixed quarantined envelope; a repeated call after commit is stale and cannot overwrite the first incident.
Do not invoke job-wide h2_quarantine for this branch; sibling command outboxes/attempts must remain byte-identical.
Do not insert/update execution binding, run scope, receipt, job, command business outcome, workspace intent, catalog, authority or registry. Do not repair/provision files or make Temporal RPC.
Transaction rollback or unknown commit is operationally reconciled using durable state; never claim a completed quarantine from a lost connection alone.
recommendation.acl: Replacement remains owner-created SECURITY DEFINER with fixed search_path pg_catalog,ifpmic,pg_temp. Preserve/reassert exact dispatcher EXECUTE, PUBLIC/runtime/operator/projector denial and helper EXECUTE denial in the same advisory-locked migration transaction.
recommendation.trust_boundary: SQL cannot attest filesystem reads. The registered dispatcher is the trusted local validator and supplies only the fixed incident code; SQL fences durable authority and state. Workspace token is service-immutable, and current WorkspaceWorker does not leave READY or advance its generation. With that preserved invariant, the existing four arguments suffice. If READY replacement/reset becomes supported, amend the protocol again to carry and compare the validated workspace token/generation.

required_boundary_and_negative_tests.oracle: Accepted DRAFT0 CREATE with READY intent, no binding and bad marker: read-only validator fails; exact live incident call quarantines only own attempt/outbox. All business rows, intent and sibling outboxes unchanged; no binding/start/admission/scope/RPC/filesystem mutation.
Valid marker is checked before reserve; normal first reserve/start flow unchanged and no prebinding incident is emitted.
RESERVED/PROVISIONING/ERROR or absent intent returns fixed wait/retry without quarantine, terminal outcome or premature binding; incident function leaves leased outbox/current attempt unchanged.

Wrong command, generation, token; NULL facts; expired lease before/at boundary; old token after reclaim; pending/dispatched/quarantined row: stale/forbidden and affected0, no durable write. Expiry sampled after blocked locks, not transaction start.

Runtime/operator/projector/PUBLIC execution denied; inactive principal, recreated same-name OID, membership/SET ROLE credential, disabled/missing deployment denied. No-binding non-create and wrong create/job/project/actor relation denied. Exact live token is a capability, not a caller-ID string.
Every other private incident code, operational code, arbitrary text and NULL cannot quarantine an unbound CREATE; existing bound allowlist remains unchanged.

Two live processes, old lease expiring while waiting on job lock and concurrent reclaim: at most current exact claim may quarantine; stale process affects0; attempt completion and outbox update are atomic.

Pause incident after its initial command lookup; another dispatcher reserves binding under job lock. Incident must re-read binding after lock: same-deployment bound path behaves as before, another-deployment binding is forbidden, never unbound-quarantined.

Snapshot all job/command/receipt/scope/binding/intent rows and sibling command outboxes/attempts. Only target current attempt/outbox changes; public error DTO never exposes WORKSPACE_IDENTITY_CONFLICT or private paths/exception text.

Fresh full chain,003 upgrade and unchanged rerun preserve 003 SHA and role registry; wrong role/OID/drift and injected004 failure roll back DDL/ledger/ACL atomically. Bound incident, receipt replay and original G4/G5 behavior retain their existing oracles.

Wrong/missing/extra marker bytes, job/child absence, symlink/FIFO/device/wrong mode/owner and inode substitution fail closed; actual I/O unavailable retries without fabricated repair. Compare filesystem tree/inodes/content before/after validation and assert no mutating provision/publish calls.

Owner disabling principal waits on the in-flight principal SHARE fence; subsequent calls fail after disable commit. Membership contention returns bounded retry; no lock inversion or broad helper capability.

risks_and_edge_cases: Unbound jobs are not deployment-owned yet: claim_delivery currently allows any enabled owner-registered dispatcher to win the first unbound claim. Do not invent a cross-deployment ownership assertion for unbound rows; do enforce exact claim capability and preserve same-deployment scope once a binding exists.

READY filesystem validation occurs outside SQL locks. This does not provide an atomic filesystem/DB transaction or protect against later same-UID malicious replacement; it follows the approved local trusted-process boundary and DB token/generation recheck at reserve.
No binding means the durable operator incident resides on outbox/attempt only. Recovery is a separate explicit operator policy; generic claim_delivery must continue excluding quarantined rows.
Bound incidents retain job-wide quarantine semantics; the narrow unbound branch must not accidentally broaden to sibling commands.

Preserve definitive identity mismatch versus temporary filesystem I/O unavailable. A missing READY tree is a definite failed READY assertion; arbitrary EIO, permission/configuration and storage failure should not be casually reclassified as proof of forged identity.
